row:
Hi there!  We are BestPals Animal Rescue Center, a no-kill non-profit animal rescue located in Holland, Michigan.  We have been in operation for 10 years now, and are primarily volunteer-run thanks to our amazing community.

We help the animals others cannot by focusing on owner-surrenders and shelter-transfers.  Our mission is to ensure our furry-friends find their best #FureverHome, with the help and care of our patient volunteers , and our foster-to-adopt program, where potential owners are able to spend a couple weeks with the dog or cat to make sure it's a positive experience for everyone in the home.

We're slowly looking to expand our presence on social media, and wanted to say hello, and thank you for your support!

#BestPalsAnimalRescueCenter #MeetYourNewBestPal
